range_note: end epoch is exclusive; --end-sh is inclusive Shanghai calendar day

filters.trend6_def: ALIAS: prior 3 completed 5m close-to-close monotonic; Up chase only if up; Down only if down
filters.trend3_def: prior 3 completed 5m close-to-close monotonic (need 4 closes); Up chase only if up; Down only if down
filters.sr1000_def: levels every 1000; near=150.0; pierce=20.0; false=pierce+reclaim within 2 bars; true=close beyond+hold 1; gate=skip false only

definitions.trend3: Relative to current 5m market window start ws: take Binance BTCUSDT 5m closes for bar opens [ws-1200, ws-900, ws-600, ws-300] (4 closes). Continuous UP = each of the 3 consecutive close-to-close steps has close[i] >= close[i-1]. Continuous DOWN symmetric (<=). Flat (all equal) = no trend. Entry: Up-chase only if UP; Down-chase only if DOWN; otherwise block. CLI: --trend3 (preferred) or --trend6 (alias enabling same filter); TREND_N=3.
definitions.trend6: ALIAS of trend3: lookback is 3 completed 5m windows (NOT 6). See definitions.trend3.
definitions.sr1000: Round levels every 1000 USD. Probe last 4 completed 5m bars. Near-level band ±150.0. Pierce beyond level by ≥20.0. FALSE break: pierce then reclaim (close back through level) within 2 bars (or close+later reclaim). TRUE break: close beyond level and hold (subsequent 1 bar(s) stay beyond; no later reclaim in probe). Gate: SKIP only false breaks on the chase side; ALLOW true breaks and non-near-level (none).

base_rules.R1: BUY fill/ask>=0.65, rem in (120,240]; SELL bid>=0.99 else hold-settle; $5; one side/window
base_rules.R2: BUY fill>=0.80; TP 0.99; skip rem<60; $5; one side/window

caveats: Filters use Binance BTCUSDT 5m OHLC, not Polymarket window open/settle prints — small timestamp/basis mismatch possible.
S/R true/false heuristics are rule-based (pierce/reclaim/hold); not ML; borderline probes labeled 'none' and allowed.
Path A fill-tape is funder wallet activity (may include bot fills), not pure manual fav-chase labels.
Path B mid±0.005 sim cannot prove click timing / depth; sparse CLOB history may miss or skew triggers.
Both filters must pass when --trend6 and --sr1000 are set; compare baseline vs filtered in the same run.
Cannot verify human latency / click timing / partial fills without L2 + own order log.
Cannot know maker vs taker fee per fill (activity has no fee field); session PnL is pre-explicit-fee.
Cannot reconstruct ask depth at click; --fetch uses mid ± 0.005 as ask/bid proxy.
One 3h session is high-variance; rules not statistically validated.
Dual-side skip is mechanical (both outcomes bought); no intent log for hedges.
Does not read .env; does not restart DAXUE/undervalued.
